meta.title: Terminal Velocity

victim.name: Max Harrow
victim.description: Fearless team captain and competitive skydiver; his formation team had just won the Summit Cup purse, to be shared with the group.

meta.tone: tense, breathless, high-altitude suspense with wind and adrenaline
meta.premise: A group of friends go skydiving together. One of them dies when their parachute fails to open. The rest must work out who sabotaged it before they land.

suspects.name: Dara Quill
suspects.description: Camera flyer with scarred knuckles and a razor tongue. Films everything, trusts nothing.
suspects.public_alibi: Filmed the awards ceremony from the stage steps; her chest cam ran the whole time.
suspects.motive: Max cut her from the sponsor deal and kept her image fees.

suspects.name: Nell Okafor
suspects.description: Team treasurer and coach. Calm, tidy, never rattled; carries the prize cheque in a pouch on her thigh.
suspects.public_alibi: Stood at Max's side for every ceremony photo; the photographer has her in every frame.
suspects.motive: As treasurer she signs for the whole purse if Max cannot.

suspects.name: Silas Brandt
suspects.description: Quiet ex-army rigger who packs every canopy by hand. Measures twice, speaks once.
suspects.public_alibi: Alone in the packing loft during the ceremony, folding spare canopies.
suspects.motive: Max planned to hand the team's rigging to a bigger firm, ending his job.

suspects.name: Rex Calloway
suspects.description: Wingsuit showman with a booming laugh and a bigger tab. Never met a crowd he didn't love.
suspects.public_alibi: Flew wingsuit stunts for the crowd on the tarmac; dozens of phones filmed him.
suspects.motive: Lost a huge bet to Max, who meant to take it out of Rex's share.

world.killer_method: At the ramp buddy check Nell swapped herself in as Max's partner. Under cover of straightening his harness she taped his main pilot-chute pocket shut with a strip of clear rigging tape and nicked his reserve cable with her hook knife. The main could not launch and the reserve cable parted when he pulled it. Motive: Nell had been skimming the team fund for a year, Max found out, and the prize purse was her only way to quietly refill it.

clues.text: On the ramp, Max's mic caught him: 'Thanks, Nell, snug as ever.' She was the last to touch his rig.
A curl of clear rigging tape is stuck inside Nell's left glove, still tacky. Nell never packs rigs, so she has no reason to carry it.
A fund statement is folded behind the prize cheque. A year of cash withdrawals is circled in Max's red pen, every one signed by Nell.
Nell's hook knife has a fresh nick, with a thread of reserve-cable green caught in the blade. Max's reserve cable was that exact green.
The pilot's ramp sheet shows Max's buddy check was assigned to Silas. It was swapped to Nell at the last minute, at her own request.
Right after the fall, Nell sobbed that Max's reserve cable had parted. From this height, nobody could have seen that.
The team packing log shows Max's reserve was repacked at 3 a.m., signed by Silas alone. No witness, no second signature.
Dara's chest-cam clip of the ceremony skips six minutes, right while the rigs sat alone. Her alibi says the camera never stopped.

items.name: Ramp-cam footage
items.description: The chest cam filmed the whole ramp check. Everyone touches everyone's rig in it, so it proves nothing unless you know exactly what to look for.

items.name: Team charm
items.description: A brass wing pin that rides the lead line on every winning jump. Holding it makes the whole stack feel luckier.

solved.title: Caught in Freefall
solved.epilogue: The footage plays on the drop-zone screen, frame by frame, and the officers stop smiling. {killer} stands very still, gloves still on, a curl of tape clinging inside. The ramp check, the empty team fund, and the careful lie all come out together. {survivors} walk away shaken but whole, and {victim}'s name goes on the cup.

wrong_culprit.title: Hard Landing
wrong_culprit.epilogue: On the ground the group names its culprit in one loud voice. An innocent jumper is led away, protesting, while {killer} walks beside the officers, calm and grieving. The prize cheque clears without a question. {survivors} will replay that day for years and only ever see what they decided to see. {victim} deserved better than a good guess.

culprit_escapes.title: Clear Skies
culprit_escapes.epilogue: {survivors} land in a tangle of lines and unanswered questions. The proof never comes together, and the ground crew is already calling {victim}'s fall an accident. {killer} signs for the prize cheque with a steady hand and a quiet smile. Every jump after that, you will count who is standing too close.
culprit_escapes.epilogue_if_downgraded: The case was in your hands, and it slipped away in the wind. The footage stuttered, the words came out wrong, and {killer} stepped past you onto solid ground. {survivors} will remember that single second for the rest of their lives. {victim}'s empty spot in the stack will say the rest.
